messages:
Infra Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler-health: gpu-autoscaler stalled in eu-west-1. model-serve-prod queue depth = 18,200 (>5k). scale controller has not progressed since 2025-11-18T12:07:33Z. potential provider 429s observed.
Ana Gonzalez: seeing it. paging SRE rotation.
SRE Rotation: oncall here, starting triage. any obvious deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy completed for commit abc123 to model-serve-prod at 2025-11-18T11:58:12Z (sha: abc123). no schema changes.
Marc Li: checking autoscaler logs now. grabbing latest controller logs and metrics.
Ana Gonzalez: grafana: gpu-pool-utilization spiked to 97% at 12:05, queue latency P95 -> 24s, P99 -> 112s. token ingestion rate doubled (burst from customer A).
Marc Li: logs show repeated: `scale_controller: backoff retrying due to provider error: RateLimitExceeded` and `scale_controller: cooldown skip blocked=true attempts=6`. looks like exponential backoff is preventing scale-ups.
Lina Patel: can we temporarily bypass the autoscaler and force scale?
SRE Rotation: yes. I'll run a manual scale to add 8 nodes to the eu-west-1 gpu pool.
SRE Rotation: running:```
# manual scale
redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool gpu-prod-eu --replicas 32
```
Ana Gonzalez: also proposing to enable the fallback model variant (quantized) for non-high-priority traffic to reduce token GPU time. can we flip routing?
Marc Li: create a traffic rule to route low-tier keys to `redwood/opt-quant-v2`. quick patch:```
# create temporary routing rule
redwoodctl route create --match "metadata.tier:low" --to-model redwood/opt-quant-v2 --region eu-west-1
```
SRE Rotation: executing route change.
Infra Oncall Bot: action acknowledged: manual scale triggered by SRE Rotation. expected nodes becoming ready ~ 6-8m.
Raj Sharma (CS): heads up — a handful of large customers are seeing elevated 5xx/timeout errors. CS already pinged top-10 customers with brief note.
Ana Gonzalez: enabling request admission control to throttle new low-priority requests to buy time. patching rate limiter:```
# throttle low-priority
redwoodctl quota update --scope low-tier --rps 20
```
Marc Li: after manual scale started, autoscaler logs show provider 429s reduced, but cooldown flag still blocking automated scale. we need a fix: remove retry escalation for provider 429s in current autoscaler version or treat 429 as soft-failure with circuit-breaker. filing bug: infra#2048.
Lina Patel: good. for immediate relief we also bumped pool maxBurst to 10 which let preemptible capacity spin up.
SRE Rotation: observed queue depth dropping: 18.2k -> 11.4k after 10m, P95 latency down to 9s. continuing to monitor.
Ana Gonzalez: started tracing slow-request samples, top cause is model kv-cache misses for long-context requests; quantized model reduces memory and speeds up per-token by ~30%.
Marc Li: note — cost will spike while we run extra nodes and fallbacks. logging cost delta to incident channel.
Raj Sharma (CS): sending updated customer note: "We're aware of degraded performance in EU region; we've applied mitigations and expect recovery in <1hr. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause."
Infra Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: manual mitigation successful: pool scaled to 32 replicas, routing rule applied, rate limits updated.
SRE Rotation: marking incident as mitigated at 2025-11-18T12:46:00Z. queue continues to drain.
Ana Gonzalez: quick post-incident list from triage: 1) autoscaler treats provider 429 as terminal backoff -> fix handler; 2) add playbook entry: manual-scale command, temporary routing to quantized variants, throttle low-priority traffic; 3) add runbook test: simulate provider 429 and ensure autoscaler still scales when capacity > threshold; 4) upward adjust min pool for eu-west-1 during business hours for heavy customers.
Marc Li: I'm drafting an RFC for autoscaler change (treat 429 as transient + bounded retry) and a follow-up code patch. assigning infra#2048 to me.
Lina Patel: I'll open a runbook PR with the new steps and add a small script to switch routing quickly.
SRE Rotation: handoff to next oncall Lina at 14:30 UTC. Lina — summary: mitigations applied (manual scale, routing to quantized model, low-tier throttling). residual items: monitor queue until baseline (<1k), watch cost, and verify autoscaler fix deploy.
Lina Patel: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and coordinate the postmortem. please add any missed items.
Marc Li: adding action item: instrument autoscaler decisions in trace logs and emit event when backoff->blocked state occurs so Alerting can notify earlier.
Ana Gonzalez: request from CS: provide timeline + impacted customers list for postmortem. Raj — can you collect and attach?
Raj Sharma (CS): yes. I'll compile and attach customer impact matrix to the postmortem doc.
SRE Rotation: closing active pager. final status: mitigated -> manual scale + routing + throttling. follow-ups: infra#2048 (autoscaler logic), runbook PR by Lina, postmortem doc w/ customer impact by Raj, add synthetic test for provider 429.
Ana Gonzalez: thanks team :heart: — create the postmortem issue and tag me and Marc.
Lina Patel: creating postmortem draft now: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/1732104567-postmortem (DRAFT). I'll ping when ready for review.
Marc Li: note for next time: consider warm standby buffer pool in eu-west-1 that doesn't scale down below X nodes for business hours. adding to infra backlog.
Infra Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: incident marked resolved.
SRE Rotation: logging final metrics: queue peak 18.2k, time to mitigation 39m, customer-visible errors peaked for 24m. handoff complete.
Lina Patel: acknowledged, will run 1-hour watch then update postmortem with timeline and action owners.
Raj Sharma (CS): posted customer notes update at 13:15 UTC. closing customer comms after postmortem.
